rationale: This repository installs NO git commit hook. `pre-commit install` is forbidden (validate_claude_env.check_session_deps_installs_no_git_hook; ops/scripts/run_pr_precommit.sh). Verification lives at `make pr-check` / `make pr`, which run the catalog with the surface-aware SKIP list. A hook-bypass token on `git commit` therefore suppresses nothing that exists — it is intent to bypass verification, and the only reason to type it is to get past a gate. Denying it costs nothing legitimate.
verification_path: make pr-check (public quality) then PR_REMEDIATE=0 make pr (publish)

notes.-n: git commit -n is --no-verify. It is NOT --dry-run. Denied on `git commit` only; -n means something else on other subcommands, hence bypass_flag_exempt_commands.
notes.SKIP: pre-commit reads SKIP as a hook-id skip list. Setting it inline on a make pr / pre-commit invocation removes hooks from the run.
notes.GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: pointing git at an empty config file is core.hooksPath by another route.
